messages.ai.err.need_profile: Make a profile first so your games are saved as yours.
messages.ai.err.not_author: Only the maker of this game can change it. Remix it to make your own copy!
messages.ai.err.bad_request: Something in that request didn't look right ({field}).
messages.ai.err.bad_game: This game has something we can't save ({errors} problems).
messages.ai.err.too_big: That's too big to save (the limit is {limit}).
messages.ai.err.bad_png: That picture needs to be a PNG.
messages.ai.err.safety: Let's keep it friendly. Please change a word or two.
messages.ai.err.bad_object: We couldn't find that drawing in this scene.
messages.ai.err.needs_object: An object block needs the object it shares.
messages.ai.err.needs_theme: A theme block needs the theme it shares.
messages.ai.err.studio_block: This block is for the Studio. Open a Studio game to use it.
messages.ai.err.art_busy: Claude is already drawing {limit} sets of art for you. Let those finish first!
messages.ai.chat.blocked: Let's keep it friendly. Try another idea!
messages.ai.chat.nothing: I couldn't turn that into a change. Could you say it another way?
messages.ai.chat.err.timeout: That took too long for me. Try a shorter ask, or one change at a time.
messages.ai.chat.err.timeout_partial: That took too long for me, so I only did the simple part:
messages.ai.chat.err.failed: Something went wrong on my side. Try again, or say it another way.
messages.ai.chat.err.failed_partial: Something went wrong on my side, so I only did the simple part:
messages.ai.chat.err.budget: I've done a lot of thinking today and need a rest. Try again tomorrow, or use simple asks like "make it a platformer".
messages.ai.chat.err.budget_partial: I'm resting for today, so I only did the simple part:
messages.ai.art.err.timeout: Claude took too long drawing this. Try again?
messages.ai.art.err.failed: Claude couldn't draw this one. Your drawing stays.
messages.ai.art.err.off: Claude's art studio is offline right now. Your drawing stays.
messages.ai.art.err.empty: There's nothing drawn here to make art from.
messages.ai.art.fallback: Here's a quick version of the look. Claude can paint a better one later.
messages.ai.kw.archetype_many: Done, I set up all {n} of them.
messages.ai.kw.gravity_off: Gravity is off, so everything floats.
messages.ai.kw.gravity_low: Gravity is low, like on the moon.
messages.ai.kw.lives: You have {n} lives now, shown as hearts.
messages.ai.kw.melee: Press E to swing a sword.
messages.ai.kw.rephrase: I'm not sure how to do that yet. Try one of these:
messages.ai.arch.ground: ground to drive and walk on
messages.ai.ask.hills: Draw the hills to drive on
messages.ai.ask.flag: Draw a flag at the end
messages.ai.ask.pig: Draw a target to knock over
messages.ai.ask.obstacle: Draw an obstacle to jump over
messages.ai.sug.racer.1: Add fuel cans that refill fuel
messages.ai.sug.racer.3: Lose if the car flips over
messages.ai.sug.fighter.3: Add a platform in the middle
messages.ai.sug.shooter.1: Add an enemy ship that shoots back
messages.ai.sug.topdown.1: Add an enemy that chases me
messages.ai.sug.topdown.2: Win when I reach the treasure
